```r
one_poll_per_pollster <- polls |> group_by(pollster) |> 
 [filter](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/filter.html)(enddate == [max](https://rdrr.io/r/base/Extremes.html)(enddate)) |>
 ungroup()
```

```r
y_bar <- [mean](https://rdrr.io/r/base/mean.html)(one_poll_per_pollster$spread)
```

```r
sigma_b <- 0.03
s2 <- [with](https://rdrr.io/r/base/with.html)(one_poll_per_pollster, [sd](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/sd.html)(spread)^2/[length](https://rdrr.io/r/base/length.html)(spread))
se <- [sqrt](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)(s2 + sigma_b^2)
```

```r
theta_0 <- 0
tau <- 0.05
B <- se^2/(se^2 + tau^2)
posterior_mean <- B*theta_0 + (1 - B)*y_bar
posterior_se <- [sqrt](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)(1/(1/se^2 + 1/tau^2))
1 - [pnorm](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/Normal.html)(0, posterior_mean, posterior_se)
#> [1] 0.803
```

```r

 mutate(weight = [seq](https://rdrr.io/r/base/seq.html)(0.3, 1, length = [length](https://rdrr.io/r/base/length.html)(grade)))
```

```r
polls <- polls |> 
 [filter](https://rdrr.io/r/stats/filter.html)(![is.na](https://rdrr.io/r/base/NA.html)(grade)) |>
 left_join(weights, by = "grade") |> 
 group_by(state) |>
 summarize(n = n(),
 avg = [sum](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html)(weight*spread)/[sum](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html)(weight), 
 sd = [sqrt](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)([sum](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html)(weight*(spread - avg)^2)/((n - 1)/n*[sum](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html)(weight))),
 n_eff = [sum](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html)(weight)^2/[sum](https://rdrr.io/r/base/sum.html)(weight^2))
```

```r
results <- results |>
 mutate(B = sd^2/n_eff/((sd^2/n_eff) + tau^2),
 posterior_mean = if_else([is.na](https://rdrr.io/r/base/NA.html)(avg), theta, B*theta_0 + (1 - B)*avg),
 posterior_se = if_else([is.na](https://rdrr.io/r/base/NA.html)(avg), tau, [sqrt](https://rdrr.io/r/base/MathFun.html)(1/(n_eff/sd^2 + 1/tau^2))))
```

